\begin{example} \end{example}[Graphs of Smooth Functions]

↗ ex:1-3

1. ch1:1.30If $U\subseteq \mathbb R^n$ is open and $f:U\to \mathbb R^k$ is smooth, the graph $\Gamma (f)$ has the canonical smooth structure determined by the global graph-coordinate chart $\pi _1|_{\Gamma (f)}:\Gamma (f)\to U$. \end{example}
